WITH per_race AS (
  SELECT cr.raceId, r.name AS race_name,
         AVG(cr.points) AS avg_points,
         COUNT(*) AS result_count
  FROM constructorResults AS cr
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
  WHERE cr.points > 1.0
  GROUP BY cr.raceId, r.name
), with_name_avg AS (
  SELECT raceId, race_name, avg_points, result_count,
         AVG(avg_points) OVER (PARTITION BY race_name) AS name_avg_points
  FROM per_race
)
SELECT raceId, race_name, avg_points, result_count,
       avg_points / name_avg_points AS ratio
FROM with_name_avg
ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
